rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act - no criminal record inquiry before conditional offer
rules.requirement: A housing provider may not use a housing application that asks about an applicant's criminal record, or make any oral or written inquiry about it, before making a conditional offer. The applicant may provide evidence of inaccuracies in the record or of rehabilitation or other mitigating factors.
rules.coverage_text: Housing providers offering rental dwelling units for residential purposes, other than a dwelling unit in an owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.
rules.exemptions: Dwelling units in owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units. A provider may consider whether an applicant has ever been convicted of drug-related criminal activity for the manufacture or production of methamphetamine on the premises of federally assisted housing, and whether the applicant is subject to a lifetime registration requirement under a State sex offender registration program.
rules.penalty: Monetary penalty of not more than $1,000 with no prior violation within five years, not more than $5,000 with one other violation within five years, and not more than $10,000 with two or more other violations within seven years; the director may also order cease and desist, return of the rental application fee and other actions.
rules.quoted_span: A housing provider shall not make any oral or written inquiry regarding an applicant’s criminal record prior to making a conditional offer.
rules.effective_date_phrase: This act shall take effect on the first day of the seventh month next following the date of enactment

rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act - criminal history disclosure before application fee
rules.requirement: Before accepting any application fee, a housing provider must disclose in writing whether its eligibility criteria include review of criminal history, and that the applicant may provide evidence of inaccuracies, rehabilitation or other mitigating factors.
rules.coverage_text: Housing providers offering rental dwelling units, other than a dwelling unit in an owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.
rules.exemptions: Dwelling units in owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.
rules.penalty: Monetary penalty of not more than $1,000, $5,000 or $10,000 depending on prior violations.

rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act - prohibited criminal records
rules.requirement: A housing provider may not, before or after a conditional offer, evaluate an applicant based on arrests or charges without conviction, expunged convictions, convictions erased by pardon, vacated or nullified convictions, juvenile adjudications of delinquency, or sealed records.
rules.coverage_text: Housing providers offering rental dwelling units, other than a dwelling unit in an owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.
rules.exemptions: Dwelling units in owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.
rules.penalty: Monetary penalty of not more than $1,000, $5,000 or $10,000 depending on prior violations.

rules.effective_date_phrase: This act shall take effect on the first day of the seventh month next following the date of enactment

rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act - lookback limits after conditional offer
rules.requirement: After a conditional offer, a housing provider may only consider convictions for listed serious crimes or lifetime sex offender registration, first degree indictable offenses within six years, second or third degree within four years, and fourth degree within one year preceding the conditional offer.
rules.key_value: First degree: six years; second or third degree: four years; fourth degree: one year

rules.penalty: Monetary penalty of not more than $1,000, $5,000 or $10,000 depending on prior violations.

rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act - withdrawal of conditional offer
rules.requirement: A housing provider may withdraw a conditional offer based on criminal record only if it determines by preponderance of the evidence that withdrawal is necessary to fulfill a substantial, legitimate, and nondiscriminatory interest, after an individualized assessment, and must give written notice of the specific reasons and an opportunity to appeal.
rules.coverage_text: Housing providers offering rental dwelling units, other than a dwelling unit in an owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.
rules.exemptions: Dwelling units in owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.
rules.penalty: Monetary penalty of not more than $1,000, $5,000 or $10,000 depending on prior violations.
rules.quoted_span: A housing provider may withdraw a conditional offer based on an applicant's criminal record only if the housing provider determines, by preponderance of the evidence, that the withdrawal is necessary to fulfill a substantial, legitimate, and nondiscriminatory interest.
rules.effective_date_phrase: This act shall take effect on the first day of the seventh month next following the date of enactment

rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act - copy of information relied upon
rules.requirement: An applicant may request, within 30 days after notice of withdrawal, a copy of all information the housing provider relied upon, including criminal records, and the provider must provide it free of charge within 10 days after a timely request.
rules.coverage_text: Housing providers offering rental dwelling units, other than a dwelling unit in an owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.
rules.exemptions: Dwelling units in owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.
rules.penalty: Monetary penalty of not more than $1,000, $5,000 or $10,000 depending on prior violations.
rules.quoted_span: A housing provider shall provide the information requested under paragraph (1) of this subsection, free of charge, within l0 days after receipt of a timely request.
rules.effective_date_phrase: This act shall take effect on the first day of the seventh month next following the date of enactment

rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act - discriminatory advertisements
rules.requirement: A housing provider may not publish any housing advertisement stating that it will not consider applicants who have been arrested or convicted of crimes or offenses, or otherwise express an unlawful limitation as to criminal record, except as permitted by the act.
rules.coverage_text: Housing providers offering rental dwelling units, other than a dwelling unit in an owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.
rules.exemptions: Drug-related criminal activity for the manufacture or production of methamphetamine on the premises of federally assisted housing, and lifetime sex offender registration requirements.
rules.penalty: Monetary penalty of not more than $1,000, $5,000 or $10,000 depending on prior violations.
rules.quoted_span: A housing provider shall not knowingly or purposefully publish, or cause to be published, any housing advertisement that explicitly provides that the housing provider will not consider any applicant who has been arrested or convicted of one or more crimes or offenses, except for drug-related criminal activity for the manufacture or production of methamphetamine on the premises of federally assisted housing, and whether the applicant is subject to a lifetime registration requirement under a State sex offender registration program.
rules.effective_date_phrase: This act shall take effect on the first day of the seventh month next following the date of enactment

rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act - no drug or alcohol testing
rules.requirement: A housing provider may not require an applicant to submit to a drug or alcohol test, or request consent to obtain information from a drug abuse treatment facility.
rules.coverage_text: Housing providers offering rental dwelling units, other than a dwelling unit in an owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.
rules.exemptions: Dwelling units in owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.
rules.penalty: Monetary penalty of not more than $1,000, $5,000 or $10,000 depending on prior violations.
rules.quoted_span: A housing provider shall not require an applicant to submit to a drug or alcohol test, or request the applicant’s consent to obtain information from a drug abuse treatment facility.
rules.effective_date_phrase: This act shall take effect on the first day of the seventh month next following the date of enactment
